download.title: Download the Kraken Scout Bundle — XMR Jackpot
download.description: Download the Kraken Scout Bundle: Kraken Miner and the Kraken Scout console in one zip. Kraken Miner is free and is the only way to win the daily Jackpot. Published SHA256 checksum, one-way mining, stop it any time.
download.h1: Download the free Kraken Miner — the only way to win the Jackpot
download.lead: The Jackpot is free and legal in all 50 states, with no age discrimination and no purchase required. Kraken Miner is how you win it: every valid batch of shares becomes an entry. It ships inside this bundle next to Kraken Scout, a free market scanner — and Kraken Pro, the optional donation upgrade that unlocks live push alerts, funds the Jackpot, and adds one extra entry.
download.minerTitle: Kraken Miner — the free miner that wins entries
download.minerBody: A one-click Windows script: it fetches xmrig 6.26.0 from the official GitHub release, checks its SHA256, writes the pool config and starts mining.
download.minerNote: This copy mines under a placeholder wallet, so nothing is credited to you. Sign in and download the miner from your dashboard to mine under your own wallet.
download.what1Body: Connects to the pool and submits shares. Each 100 accepted shares is one entry in the open drawing.
download.what2Body: The free Kraken Scout console: a background scanner watching the market around the clock. Kraken Pro (an optional donation) unlocks the live push alerts on top.
download.verifyTitle: Verify the file before you run it
download.verifyBody: The checksum published next to the download is the same one the dashboard shows. After downloading, compute the SHA256 of the file and compare it with the hash above:
download.verifyNote: If the two do not match, do not run the file — delete it and download it again. The same manifest, including the size and build time, is published at /api/downloads/bundle-info.
download.capabilityTitle: What the miner can and cannot do
download.capability1: It sends hashpower to the pool, one way. It never asks for wallet keys, cannot move funds, and does not need a deposit or a wallet address before it starts working. A wallet is only involved when you claim a prize.
download.capability2: The bundle's mining bot is on unless you clear the single opt-out checkbox during setup. Nothing mines after you uncheck it, and closing the miner stops it immediately.
download.before1: Mining needs no account and no deposit.
download.before2: Claiming a prize does: log in, connect a Monero wallet, claim within seven days.
download.before3: Entries are counted per drawing, so joining before a round closes still counts for that round.
download.englishOnlyNote: The four-steps page and the winners page are in English only for now.
download.trouble1: Unzip the bundle first; the launcher expects its files beside it.
download.trouble2: Allow the miner outbound access in your firewall so it can reach the pool.
download.trouble3: Check the dashboard — shares appear once the pool accepts them, which can trail your miner slightly.

status.title: Relay status — XMR Jackpot
status.footnote: This page reports what the pool PC monitor last measured. If it says unknown, the relay may still be fine — the monitor is the part that is not reporting.
download.scoutBody: Kraken Scout is free: the console plus the background scanner, installed in one go. Kraken Pro is the optional donation upgrade — {usd} USD ({price} XMR) for {days} days — that unlocks live push alerts, funds the Jackpot, and earns one extra entry per account.
download.scoutNote: Downloading is free and no account is needed to run the Miner. A free sign-up at xmrjackpot.com is only needed for the dashboard, the entry controls and account settings.
download.treasuryBody: Kraken Pro is the only paid item on this site. 70% of each Pro order is credited straight into the daily Jackpot; the operator keeps 30% to run the pool. No subscription and no auto-renewal: one donation, {days} days of Pro, one extra jackpot entry per account.
download.ownerKraken: The Funded Challenge, its rules, targets and account funding; the referral ladder and its cap. Kraken sets these and pays them under Kraken's terms.
download.ownerPool: Entries from mining shares, the drawings and claims, and Scout Pro. We run these; Kraken has no part in them.
download.ownerMeet: Where the two meet: a Kraken bonus reaches the pot only after the operator records receiving it. Kraken never pays the jackpot directly.
download.stepsTitle: From download to first entries — step by step
download.step1Body: Download KrakenScoutBundle.zip from this page and compare its SHA256 with the published checksum. A match means the bytes are the ones the site published.
download.step2Body: Extract the zip anywhere (Desktop is fine) and open the KrakenScoutBundle folder it creates. Everything the installer needs travels beside it.
download.step3Body: Double-click Install Kraken Scout.bat. It stages the app trees, fetches the pinned xmrig miner and builds the Python environment on its own — a few minutes, one window.
download.step4Body: The setup window asks one question: the Miner Bot. Leave it checked (the default) so your mining earns Jackpot entries, or uncheck it to run Scout without mining. Nothing else is asked for.
download.step5Body: Double-click Launch Kraken.bat: the console dashboard opens in your browser and the scanner starts in its own window. From the first accepted job you are mining the shared pool.
download.step6Body: Open the dashboard at xmrjackpot.com to see shares, entries and today's pot. That is the whole flow — no deposits, no fees, no purchase.
scoutpro.title: Kraken Pro — live push alerts for trading — XMR Jackpot
scoutpro.description: Kraken Pro is the optional upgrade to the free Kraken Scout: live push alerts for crypto trading, funded by a donation that is credited into the daily Jackpot — with one extra jackpot entry for Pro accounts.
scoutpro.h1: Kraken Pro — the upgrade that unlocks live push alerts
scoutpro.lead: Kraken Scout is free. Kraken Pro unlocks the parts of the scanner that need the server: live push alerts while you trade, jackpot notifications, and profile sync across devices. The Pro donation contributes directly to the Jackpot pool, and Pro accounts receive one extra jackpot entry.
scoutpro.perk1Body: The scanner's live signals, jackpot notifications and the on-miner watchdog, pushed to your devices the moment they fire — the alerts that cannot wait for you to open the dashboard.
scoutpro.perk2Body: Your scanner profile, alert setup and controls follow you to whichever device you sign in on.
scoutpro.perk3Body: While Pro is active, the account receives one additional entry per drawing — one extra entry, one per account.
scoutpro.priceBody: {usd} USD (≈{xmr} Monero) for {days} days. 70% of every order is credited into the daily Jackpot; 30% keeps the pool running. No subscription, no auto-renewal.
scoutpro.signupBody: Sign-up at xmrjackpot.com is free: the dashboard, the entry controls and account settings live there. Unlock Kraken Pro from the dashboard when you are ready.
scoutpro.entryNote: The extra entry is automatic while Pro is active; it does not change the mining entry rule.
